title: Net Addict
paragraphs: “Wait a minute, Itsuki. I think we should ask Motoyasu-kun about something else too. There might be others besides that Rishia-san who need to be rescued and could become our companions.”
“Understood…”
“Motoyasu-kun, are there any other companions for Itsuki?”
“Everyone besides Stalker Pig was a traitor, I say.”
“…What a terrible world. We really do need to rescue her quickly.”
“Then, do you remember any other reliable companions? Were there any in my group?” Ren asked me as well.
This one’s easy. I turned my gaze to Éclair and Assistant. Both of them looked slightly displeased.
What does that mean?
“Ren’s companions are Éclair and Assistant. The others were the slaves that Father had in his territory.”
“Eclair and Wyndia, huh…”
Ren looked at Éclair and Assistant. He looked somewhat disappointed.
“What is it, Amaki-dono? Am I not good enough?”
“I’m stronger than most people now, and so is Gaelion.”
“That’s not what I mean… I just feel like I’ve heard this before.”
Ren seemed dissatisfied with Éclair and Assistant. Well, I do remember it being like this in the first world too.
“In the first world, they were slaves, but in the previous loops, there were others who became companions… I’d suggest focusing on recruiting those who were chosen as the Seven Star Weapon Heroes.”
“Reasonable. Motoyasu, is there anyone else?”

“In the first world, the Claw was Filo-tan, the Hammer was the older sister, the staff was Trash, the Whip was Assistant, the Projectile Weapon was Stalker Pig, the axe was Green, and the Gauntlet was a Hakuko slave.”
“Three… three of them were Filolials?”
Hmm? Why three? I feel like Ren is misunderstanding something.
“It looks like Itsuki’s destined partner is among them too. So, did the holders change during the loop?”

“Of course. But that was in the previous loop. It was an emergency then, so I can’t be certain who the rightful holders were, but the Hammer was Sakura-chan, the Projectile Weapon was Yuki-chan, the Whip was Assistant, the Staff was Trash, and the Claw was the panda.”
“Yuki-chan is also a candidate… wait, Sakura-chan wielded the Hammer? But the current Sakura-chan doesn’t use any weapons.”
“I’ll work hard so I can be chosen!”
“Hmm? Sakura’s sleepy…”
“The previous Sakura-chan was tall and a dual wielder.”
“So just by how she’s raised, even Sakura-chan’s appearance can change. By the way, about Wyndia-chan being chosen by the Whip…”
Father looked at Assistant with a slight grin. Assistant made a whipping motion. Rival had her hands on her cheeks and looked speechless. She looked like a painting of The Scream.
“By the way, who was the panda that became the Claw Hero?”
“The mercenary panda that Father bonded with in Siltvelt.”
“Siltvelt…”
Ren and Itsuki crossed their arms and gave Father a half-lidded stare for some reason. At that moment, I heard loud shouting. They’ve been noisy for a while now!
“Big Sis!”
“Hey, shut up! Tonight’s for partying!”
You’re the one who’s loud. If you’re going to be noisy, do it somewhere else.
“Now that you mention it, I remember Naofumi looking out from the inn’s window and making a fuss with the panda. So it was that one?”
“Uh… if it’s a mercenary, that might be difficult.”

Father’s eyes were darting around, and for some reason, everyone’s gaze was converging on a certain spot in the tavern. The mercenaries were still making a ruckus. Honestly, they were really annoying.
“Hey, Motoyasu-kun.”
“What is it?”
“There’s a panda over there, but is it a different one?”
I checked carefully after being told. A panda beastman, surrounded by dog-like followers, was heartily eating inside the tavern. These guys were the noisy ones from earlier. …I recognize them.
“Ah, yes. That’s definitely the panda.”

When I pointed, Father looked slightly exasperated and slumped his shoulders. Come to think of it, last time, the panda was debating whether to go to Zeltoble or not. In the end, since the panda became Father’s companion, they didn’t go to Zeltoble, but if we don’t get involved, it looks like they end up going there. Eventually, Itsuki spoke in a quiet voice.
“Coincidences are amazing, aren’t they?”
“Yeah. Naofumi, why don’t you go scout them out right away?”
“I’m excited about the panda, but… how did you even scout them?”
“Actually, they have a thing for cute stuff, I say. That panda.”
“Ah… so they dressed up their companions like Sakura-chan and Imiya-chan?”
“Maybe. Naofumi seems to like that kind of gap.”
Noticing the gazes directed at them, the panda looked our way with a slightly displeased expression. I pretended not to notice.
“For now, Naofumi. Why don’t you try scouting them somehow?”
“Eh!? Do I really have to do it?”
“It’s for the sake of the world.”
Persuaded by Ren and Itsuki, Father reluctantly stood up. Oh, another negotiation is about to begin. If it’s Father, I’m sure it’ll be a success.
“Got it. I’ll try to blend in and invite them, but don’t get your hopes up.”
“Iwatani-dono, you don’t have to push yourself, you know?”
“But I can’t just ignore someone who might become a hero… I’ll give it a shot.”
And so, Father approached the panda’s group.
“Drink up!”
“Big Sis!”
“Yeah!”

He blended into the group so naturally and started clapping along. The panda’s energetic presence had lifted the spirits of the adventurers in the tavern, creating an atmosphere where anyone could join in and drink. I observed Father for a while, but there was no sign of him coming back.
“It looks like it’ll take a while.”
“He’s probably trying to get to know them first.”
“Ugh… Gaelion’s aiming to become the Claw Hero.”
“So, what should we do?”
“It’s already pretty late at night.”
Itsuki sent a hand signal to Father. Father gave a subtle nod. Does that mean we can go back?
“Well, knowing Naofumi-san, he’ll get along with them and handle the recruitment well. Let’s head back so we don’t get in the way.”
“We’ve already secured their consent.”
“Yeah… Alright, everyone. Let’s head back to the inn so we don’t cause trouble for Naofumi-san.”
And so, we left the tavern, leaving the recruitment to Father. On the way back, Ren spoke absentmindedly.
“Still… isn’t this kind of thing more suited to Motoyasu in the first place?”
“Are you talking about a mixer?”

How nostalgic. Back when I had just entered high school, I went a few times. Unlike in college, they were wholesome mixers, more suited for students. If I ignore the fact that my partners were pigs, well, they aren’t bad memories.
“I’ve had some experience. But that was before I came to this world.”
“Some experience? I don’t mean to be rude, but I thought someone like Motoyasu-san would have had a lot more.”
“Yeah. You seem like the type who’s been to countless ones. At least based on your looks.”
“After going a few times, no one invited me anymore.”
“Ah… Well, Motoyasu-san, you do have a really good-looking face. You probably stole all the girls at the mixers.”
“I see. That would definitely make the other guys not want to invite you.”
“It was with pigs, you know?”
“Right… Now, that’s the current you. Seriously…”

Itsuki looked completely exhausted. Even if you gather a bunch of pigs, at best, you’d get pork cutlets. What matters is not the quantity, but the quality. The miracle of encountering a one-of-a-kind existence like Filo-tan, radiant with divine grace and overflowing with love—that’s what’s truly important.
“Still, Naofumi is way too good at negotiations. He blended in so smoothly. Is he really an otaku?”
“He’s Father, after all.”
“What’s with that ‘Father’? That’s not what I meant. It’s just, in my mind, otakus are supposed to be socially awkward.”
“If anyone’s socially awkward, it’s probably Ren-san.”
“What was that? …Well, whatever. I’ve gotten used to Itsuki’s sharp tongue by now.”
That’s true. Itsuki has a knack for casually saying things that get under people’s skin. And the worst part is, he does it completely unconsciously.
“Anyway, Ren-san, in Naofumi-san’s case, he’s not really a ‘normie.’ He’s what you call a ‘net addict.’”
“Is that so? You know a lot about this, Itsuki.”

A net addict… Was that what Father was? If I recall correctly, it means someone whose life is fulfilled online. It’s like the internet version of someone whose real life is thriving—like I used to be.

In the first world, Father had such a sharp glare that he’d bite anyone who came close, but in the other worlds, he’s always kind and seems to enjoy talking to people. He’s got charisma. I bet he even hung out with friends he met online and had drinking parties or something.
“As expected of Father.”
“You’re just making stuff up again…”
“What exactly is ‘as expected,’ anyway…?”

And so, we left the recruitment of the panda to Father. Sakura-chan and Kou seemed satisfied after silently eating the food that had been brought to them. Yuki-chan, on the other hand, was apparently restraining herself for the sake of the upcoming race. But her expression showed no signs of regret.
“Well then, I’ll head to Melromarc to search for this Rishia-san.”
“It’s still nighttime, though…”
“I can’t just sit around and wait here.”
Saying that, Itsuki teleported away using a portal. What a restless guy.
Huh? Kou isn’t here either? Now that I think about it, Kou did say he was going to help Itsuki. And so, the night quietly came to an end. The next morning, instead of bringing back the panda…
For some reason, Father returned, looking sleepy, with Older Sister.
